answer: Stop sybils with a dawn auction on a marble knoll. Each dawn, one knoll seat opens: the single vantage from which influence flows that epoch. To claim it, an identity stakes a marble bond priced by the seats its funder already holds — the k-th seat from one funder costs k squared marble, so N seats cost roughly N cubed while yielding one shared flow. Yesterday's seat cannot be reused: each dawn re-prices from zero, and a lent knoll seat forfeits its marble at once. One honest agent pays one marble for one seat; a clone factory pays cubic marble for the same single knoll.
